description: Switch which page is ACTIVE — the page the content tools target. Subsequent describe_video / inspect_layers / all content tools read and write this page until the active page changes again. Pages are addressed by 0-based index from describe_video's pages block. Selecting the already-active page is a harmless no-op; fails on an out-of-range index.

index.description: 0-based index of the page to make active.

projectId.description: Opaque project id (a v4 UUID, from list_projects/create_project). Selects which existing project this call mutates.

name: select_page

outputSchema.description: The result envelope every Morpha tool returns.

data.description: The payload, shaped by the tool.

editorUrl.description: Opens this project in the editor.

note.description: What to do next when not ready.

status.description: For cache-backed readers: whether the answer was ready.
